NextBiomeEnemyShrineUpgrade_Flavor.name: “Upon this night shall distant dangers come, that Fear may spread.”

MinibossCountShrineUpgrade.name: Vow of Shadow
MinibossCountShrineUpgrade.description: All {$Keywords.EncounterPlural} with {$Keywords.MiniBossPlural} contain no fewer than {#ShrinePenaltyFormat}{$MetaUpgradeData.MinibossCountShrineUpgrade.ChangeValue} {#Prev}{$Keywords.ExtraMiniboss}.

MinibossCountShrineUpgrade_Flavor.name: “Upon this night shall shadows multiply, that Fear may spread.”

BiomeSpeedShrineUpgrade.name: Vow of Time
BiomeSpeedShrineUpgrade.description: You have {#ShrinePenaltyFormat}{$MetaUpgradeData.BiomeSpeedShrineUpgrade.DisplayValue} {#Prev}to fight through each {$Keywords.Biome} {#ItalicFormat}(or else...){#Prev}.

BiomeSpeedShrineUpgrade_Flavor.name: “Upon this night there shall be not a moment's peace, that Fear may spread.”

BoonSkipShrineUpgrade.name: Vow of Forfeit
BoonSkipShrineUpgrade.description: The first {#ShrinePenaltyFormat}{$MetaUpgradeData.BoonSkipShrineUpgrade.ChangeValue} {#Prev}{$Keywords.GodBoonPluralAlt} in each {$Keywords.Biome} become {!Icons.Onion} instead.

BoonSkipShrineUpgrade_Flavor.name: “Upon this night shall favors turn to tears, that Fear may spread.”

BoonManaReserveShrineUpgrade.name: Vow of Hubris
BoonManaReserveShrineUpgrade.description: After you choose a {$Keywords.GodBoon}, {$Keywords.ReserveMana} {#ManaFormat}{$MetaUpgradeData.BoonManaReserveShrineUpgrade.ChangeValue}{#Prev}{!Icons.Mana} for each {$Keywords.Rarity} greater than {#BoldFormatGraft}Common{#Prev}.

BoonManaReserveShrineUpgrade_Flavor.name: “Upon this night shall pride of gods fall short, that Fear may spread.”

BanUnpickedBoonsShrineUpgrade.name: Vow of Denial
BanUnpickedBoonsShrineUpgrade.description: After you choose a {$Keywords.GodBoon}, {#ShrinePenaltyFormat}{$MetaUpgradeData.BanUnpickedBoonsShrineUpgrade.ChangeValue} {#Prev}unpicked blessings shall not appear again this night.

BanUnpickedBoonsShrineUpgrade_Flavor.name: “Upon this night shall blessings be withheld, that Fear may spread.”

LimitGraspShrineUpgrade.name: Vow of Void
LimitGraspShrineUpgrade.description: You have access to {#ShrinePenaltyFormat}{$MetaUpgradeData.LimitGraspShrineUpgrade.ChangeValue}% {#Prev} of your {!Icons.ManaCrystal}{#MemFormatBold}Grasp {#Prev}for your {$Keywords.CardPlural}.

LimitGraspShrineUpgrade_Flavor.name: “Upon this night shall my beliefs be gone, that Fear may spread.”

EnemyEliteShrineUpgrade_Flavor.name: “Upon this night shall newfound terrors manifest, that Fear may spread.”

BossDifficultyShrineUpgrade.name: Vow of Rivals
BossDifficultyShrineUpgrade.description: The {$Keywords.Boss} of the first {#ShrinePenaltyFormat}{$MetaUpgradeData.BossDifficultyShrineUpgrade.ChangeValue} {#Prev}{$Keywords.BiomePlural} shall be stronger in various ways.

BossDifficultyShrineUpgrade_Few.name: Vow of Rivals
BossDifficultyShrineUpgrade_Few.description: The {$Keywords.Boss} of the first {#ShrinePenaltyFormat}{$MetaUpgradeData.BossDifficultyShrineUpgrade.ChangeValue} {#Prev}{$Keywords.BiomePlural} shall be stronger in various ways.

BossDifficultyShrineUpgrade_Many.name: Vow of Rivals
BossDifficultyShrineUpgrade_Many.description: The {$Keywords.Boss} of the first {#ShrinePenaltyFormat}{$MetaUpgradeData.BossDifficultyShrineUpgrade.ChangeValue} {#Prev}{$Keywords.BiomePlural} shall be stronger in various ways.

BossDifficultyShrineUpgrade_Other.name: Vow of Rivals
BossDifficultyShrineUpgrade_Other.description: The {$Keywords.Boss} of the first {#ShrinePenaltyFormat}{$MetaUpgradeData.BossDifficultyShrineUpgrade.ChangeValue} {#Prev}{$Keywords.BiomePlural} shall be stronger in various ways.

BossDifficultyShrineUpgrade_Flavor.name: “Upon this night shall adversaries rise, that Fear may spread.”

UnusedWeaponBonusTrait.name: Grave Thirst
UnusedWeaponBonusTrait.description: Whenever you can depart {$Keywords.RoomPlural}, also unearth {#ResourceFormat}+{$TooltipData.AddResources.MetaCurrency}{#Prev}{!Icons.MetaCurrencyIcon}.

UnusedWeaponBonusTrait2.name: Gravest Thirst
UnusedWeaponBonusTrait2.description: Departing {$Keywords.RoomPlural} unearths {#ResourceFormat}+{$TooltipData.AddResources.MetaCurrency}{#Prev}{!Icons.MetaCurrencyIcon}. Vanquishing {$Keywords.BossPlural} unearths at least {#ResourceFormat}+{$ConsumableData.GemPointsDrop.AddResources.GemPoints}{#Prev}{!Icons.GemPointsIcon}.

FallbackGold.name: Shared Wealth
FallbackGold.description: Gain {#MoneyFormatBold}+{$TooltipData.ExtractData.GoldAmount}{!Icons.Currency} {#Prev}with which to later pick out something you like.

InfernalContractBoon.name: Champion of Elysium *
InfernalContractBoon.description: {#ItalicFormat}Congratulations! {#Prev}You may claim {#UpgradeFormat}1 {#Prev}rare item for {#MoneyFormatBold}0{#Prev}{!Icons.Currency} prior to each {$Keywords.Boss}.

InfernalContractBoon_FlavorText.name: * Some restrictions apply. Offer not available in all realms. Title may be rescinded without notice.

SurfacePenalty.name: Chthonic Fate
SurfacePenalty.description: Those born to the line of Hades are bound to the Underworld...

ErisCurseTrait.name: “Blessing” of Strife
ErisCurseTrait.description: Your foes deal {#PenaltyFormat}+{$CurrentRun.ErisCurseDamageMultiplierDisplay}% {#Prev}damage. This grows each {$Keywords.EncounterAlt}.

ErisCurse_FlavorText.name: There are those who can inspire wrath and malice through no fault of their own.

ZeusSprintBoon.name: Thunder Rush
ZeusSprintBoon.description: {$Keywords.DashSet} causes surrounding foes to be struck by lightning bolts.

ZeusCastBoon.name: Storm Ring
ZeusCastBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.CastSet} cause lightning bolts to repeatedly strike {#BoldFormatGraft}1 {#Prev}foe at a time in the binding circle.

ZeusManaBoon.name: Ionic Gain
ZeusManaBoon.description: In each {$Keywords.EncounterAlt}, an {$Keywords.ManaDropZeus} appears in the area and restores {#ItalicFormat}all {#Prev}{!Icons.Mana} when used.

CastAnywhereBoon.name: Lightning Lance
CastAnywhereBoon.description: Hold {$Keywords.Cast} to aim where the binding circle appears. Foes within are struck by lightning.

ZeusManaBoltBoon.name: Power Surge
ZeusManaBoltBoon.description: Whenever you use {!Icons.Mana}, a random surrounding foe is struck by lightning.

BoltRetaliateBoon.name: Divine Vengeance
BoltRetaliateBoon.description: After you take damage, your foe is struck by lightning, and again {#BoldFormat}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.StrikeChance}% {#Prev}of the time.

DoubleBoltBoon.name: Double Strike
DoubleBoltBoon.description: Your lightning bolt effects may strike {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TraitData.DoubleBoltBoon.NumStrikes} {#Prev}times.

LightningDebuffGeneratorBoon.name: Electric Overload
LightningDebuffGeneratorBoon.description: Your chain-lightning deals more damage and bounces up to {#BoldFormatGraft}+{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Bounces} {#Prev}times.

FocusLightningBoon.name: Static Shock
FocusLightningBoon.description: Your strikes emit chain-lightning that bounces up to {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Bounces} {#Prev}times, but you {$Keywords.ReserveMana} {#ManaFormat}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.TooltipCost}{#Prev}{!Icons.Mana}.

EchoExpirationBoon.name: Arc Flash
EchoExpirationBoon.description: Damage from {$Keywords.Omega} immediately activates {$Keywords.Echo} effects and makes them stronger.

ElementalDamageFloorBoon.name: Air Quality
ElementalDamageFloorBoon.description: While you have at least {$TraitData.ElementalDamageFloorBoon.ActivationRequirements.1.Value}{!Icons.CurseAir}, you can never deal less damage than the limit.

SpawnKillBoon.name: Shocking Loss
SpawnKillBoon.description: Whenever you first deal damage to susceptible foes, you may destroy them outright.

SpawnKillBoon_FlavorText.name: The lightning bolt forever remains a symbol of the impulsive power of the Lord of Olympus.

HeraWeaponBoon.name: Sworn Strike
HeraWeaponBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.AttackSet} deal more damage and inflict {$Keywords.Link}.

HeraSpecialBoon.name: Sworn Flourish
HeraSpecialBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.SpecialSet} deal more damage and inflict {$Keywords.Link}.

HeraCastBoon.name: Engagement Ring
HeraCastBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.CastSet} inflict {$Keywords.Link} and immediately deal damage based on foes in the binding circle.

SpawnCastDamageBoon.name: Rousing Reception
SpawnCastDamageBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.CastSet} damage any foes as they join the {$Keywords.EncounterAlt}, wherever they appear.

HeraSprintBoon.name: Nexus Rush
HeraSprintBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.Sprint} inflicts {$Keywords.Link} on surrounding foes, and deals damage when it does.

HeraManaBoon.name: Born Gain
HeraManaBoon.description: Whenever you run out of {!Icons.Mana}, {$Keywords.ReserveManaAlt} until the next {$Keywords.RoomAlt} to restore {#ItalicFormat}all {#Prev}{!Icons.Mana}.

LinkedDeathDamageBoon.name: Dying Wish
LinkedDeathDamageBoon.description: Whenever {$Keywords.Link}-afflicted foes are slain, damage all other {$Keywords.Link}-afflicted foes.

DamageSharePotencyBoon.name: Hereditary Bane
DamageSharePotencyBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.Link} effects deal more damage and last {#BoldFormat}+{$TooltipData.ExtractData.TooltipDuration} Sec.

OmegaHeraProjectileBoon.name: Fine Line
OmegaHeraProjectileBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.Omega} create a fissure that deals damage in a long line, but use {#ManaFormat}+{$TooltipData.ExtractData.ManaCostAddition}{!Icons.Mana}{#Prev}.

DamageShareRetaliateBoon.name: Extended Family
DamageShareRetaliateBoon.description: Your damaging effects from Olympians are stronger for each {$Keywords.GodBoon}-giver you have.

CommonGlobalDamageBoon.name: Uncommon Grace
CommonGlobalDamageBoon.description: While none of your other {$Keywords.GodBoonPluralNoTooltip} are {$Keywords.CommonWithCount}, deal more damage.

ElementalRarityUpgradeBoon.name: Proper Upbringing
ElementalRarityUpgradeBoon.description: While you have at least {$TraitData.ElementalRarityUpgradeBoon.ActivationRequirements.1.Value}{$Keywords.AllElementsWithCount}, {#ItalicFormat}all {#Prev}your {$Keywords.CommonWithCount} {$Keywords.GodBoonPluralNoTooltip} gain {$Keywords.Rarity}.

AllElementalBoon_FlavorText.name: The more disparate personalities a family contains, the stronger it can be; thus says the Queen.

PoseidonWeaponBoon.name: Wave Strike
PoseidonWeaponBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.AttackSet} hit foes with a splash that knocks other foes away.

PoseidonSpecialBoon.name: Wave Flourish
PoseidonSpecialBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.SpecialSet} hit foes with a splash that knocks other foes away.

PoseidonCastBoon.name: Tidal Ring
PoseidonCastBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.CastSet} also immediately hit foes with a powerful splash that inflicts {$Keywords.KnockbackAmplify}.

PoseidonExCastBoon.name: Geyser Spout
PoseidonExCastBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.CastEX} gains {$Keywords.BaseDamage} and knocks foes away.

OmegaPoseidonProjectileBoon.name: Ocean Swell
OmegaPoseidonProjectileBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.Omega} also launch a wide wave ahead that knocks foes away, but use {#ManaFormat}+{$TooltipData.ExtractData.ManaCostAddition}{!Icons.Mana}{#Prev}.

PoseidonSprintBoon.name: Breaker Rush
PoseidonSprintBoon.description: Whenever you {$Keywords.Sprint}, hit the first foe you run into with a blast that knocks foes away.

PoseidonManaBoon.name: Flood Gain
PoseidonManaBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.Omega} make you briefly restore any {!Icons.Mana} you use, repeatable after {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Interval} Sec.

PoseidonStatusBoon.name: Slippery Slope
PoseidonStatusBoon.description: Your splash effects from {#BoldFormatGraft}Poseidon {#Prev}also inflict {$Keywords.KnockbackAmplify}, and {$Keywords.KnockbackAmplify} deals more damage.

RoomRewardBonusBoon.name: Buried Treasure
RoomRewardBonusBoon.description: Any {$Keywords.MetaRewardAlt} and {!Icons.MoneyDrop} are worth more, and you receive {!Icons.Currency_NoTooltip}, {!Icons.HealthRestore}, and {!Icons.MetaCurrencyIcon} now.

EncounterStartOffenseBuffBoon.name: Hydraulic Might
EncounterStartOffenseBuffBoon.description: At the start of each {$Keywords.EncounterAlt}, your {$Keywords.AttackSet} and {$Keywords.SpecialSet} are stronger for {#BoldFormat}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.TooltipDuration} Sec.

DoubleRewardBoon.name: Sea Star
DoubleRewardBoon.description: Whenever you claim rewards other than {$Keywords.GodBoonPlural}, {!Icons.Hammer}, or rare resources, a copy may appear.

FocusDamageShaveBoon.name: High Surf
FocusDamageShaveBoon.description: Hit surrounding foes with a powerful splash as they start to strike, but you {$Keywords.ReserveMana} {#ManaFormat}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.TooltipCost}{#Prev}{!Icons.Mana}.

AmplifyConeBoon.name: King Tide
AmplifyConeBoon.description: Your splash effects from {#BoldFormatGraft}Poseidon {#Prev}are larger, and deal more damage to {$Keywords.BossPlural}.

AmplifyConeBoon_FlavorText.name: The sea covers most of the world's surface already; pray it does not cover the rest.

ApolloWeaponBoon.name: Nova Strike
ApolloWeaponBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.AttackSet} deal more damage in a larger area.

ApolloSpecialBoon.name: Nova Flourish
ApolloSpecialBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.SpecialSet} deal more damage in a larger area.

ApolloCastBoon.name: Solar Ring
ApolloCastBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.CastSet} inflict {$Keywords.Blind}, and deal a burst of damage before they expire.

ApolloExCastBoon.name: Prominence Flare
ApolloExCastBoon.description: After your {$Keywords.CastEX} expires, rapidly deal damage in the area for {#BoldFormat}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.BeamDuration} Sec.

ApolloSprintBoon.name: Blinding Rush
ApolloSprintBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.Sprint} is faster and inflicts {$Keywords.Blind} on surrounding foes.

ApolloCastAreaBoon.name: Super Nova
ApolloCastAreaBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.CastSet} expand in size until they expire.

ApolloBlindBoon.name: Back Burner
ApolloBlindBoon.description: Foes with {$Keywords.Blind} take more damage if struck from behind.

ApolloRetaliateBoon.name: Light Smite
ApolloRetaliateBoon.description: After you take damage, automatically damage and {$Keywords.Blind} {#ItalicFormat}all {#Prev} foes in the vicinity.

PerfectDamageBonusBoon.name: Perfect Image
PerfectDamageBonusBoon.description: You deal more damage until you take damage. If you take no more for {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Cooldown} Sec.{#Prev}, regain this.

DoubleStrikeChanceBoon.name: Extra Dose
DoubleStrikeChanceBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.Attack} has a chance to hit {$TraitData.DoubleStrikeChanceBoon.StringTextNumeral} times.

ElementalRallyBoon.name: Self Healing
ElementalRallyBoon.description: While you have at least {$TraitData.ElementalRallyBoon.ActivationRequirements.1.Value}{!Icons.CurseFire}, whenever you take damage, restore some {!Icons.Health}.

DoubleExManaBoon.name: Exceptional Talent
DoubleExManaBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.AttackEX} and {$Keywords.SpecialEX} fire {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TraitData.DoubleExManaBoon.PropertyChanges.[1].WeaponProperties.NumProjectileWaves} {#Prev}times, but use more {!Icons.Mana}.

DoubleExManaBoon_FlavorText.name: We cannot all be the best at what we do, for the god of light has much of it covered.

AphroditeWeaponBoon.name: Flutter Strike
AphroditeWeaponBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.AttackSet} deal more damage to nearby foes.

AphroditeSpecialBoon.name: Flutter Flourish
AphroditeSpecialBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.SpecialSet} deal more damage to nearby foes.

AphroditeCastBoon.name: Rapture Ring
AphroditeCastBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.CastSet} inflict {$Keywords.Weak}, and damage foes while dragging them toward the center.

AphroditeSprintBoon.name: Passion Rush
AphroditeSprintBoon.description: {$Keywords.DashSet} damages surrounding foes and inflicts {$Keywords.Weak}, and again once you stop.

AphroditeManaBoon.name: Glamour Gain
AphroditeManaBoon.description: You automatically inflict {$Keywords.Weak} on nearby foes and gradually restore {!Icons.Mana} near them.

HealthRewardBonusBoon.name: Spiritual Affirmation
HealthRewardBonusBoon.description: Gain {!Icons.HealthUp} and {!Icons.ManaUp} now and for the rest of this night.

DoorHealToFullBoon.name: Healthy Rebound
DoorHealToFullBoon.description: Whenever you exit a {$Keywords.RoomAlt}, restore {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.TooltipHeal}%{!Icons.Health} {#Prev}if you have not lost too much.

HighHealthOffenseBoon.name: Shameless Attitude
HighHealthOffenseBoon.description: You deal more damage. While you have at least {#BoldFormat}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Threshold}%{#Prev}{!Icons.Health}, the bonus is doubled.

ElementalDodgeBoon.name: Wispy Wiles
ElementalDodgeBoon.description: Gain a chance to {$Keywords.Dodge} for each {!Icons.CurseAir} you have.

RandomStatusBoon.name: Nervous Wreck
RandomStatusBoon.description: Whenever you inflict {$Keywords.Weak}, also randomly inflict {$Keywords.StatusPlural} from other Olympians.

RandomStatusBoon_FlavorText.name: Love and beauty can be so overwhelming as to strike each of the senses numb.

DemeterWeaponBoon.name: Ice Strike

DemeterSpecialBoon.name: Ice Flourish

DemeterSprintBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.Sprint} forms a {$Keywords.SlowField} around you that lingers after you stop.

DemeterManaBoon.description: After remaining inactive for {#BoldFormat}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.TooltipMovePenaltyDuration} Sec.{#Prev}, rapidly restore {!Icons.Mana} until you act.

CastAttachBoon.name: Local Climate
CastAttachBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.CastEX} deals more damage. If you are in the binding circle, the bonus is doubled.

PlantHealthBoon.name: Plentiful Forage
PlantHealthBoon.description: Whenever you gather resources from a {$Keywords.RoomAlt}, restore some {!Icons.Health}. Gain {#BoldFormat}+1{#Prev}{!Icons.SeedMysteryIcon} now.

CastNovaBoon.name: Arctic Gale
CastNovaBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.CastSet} also create a {$Keywords.SlowField} around the binding circle.

BoonGrowthBoon.name: Steady Growth
BoonGrowthBoon.description: Whenever you clear enough {$Keywords.EncounterPlural}, a random {$Keywords.GodBoon} you have gains {$Keywords.Rarity}.

SlowExAttackBoon.name: Weed Killer
SlowExAttackBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.AttackEX} deals more damage, but uses {#ManaFormat}+{$TooltipData.ExtractData.ManaCostAddition}{!Icons.Mana}{#Prev}.

ReserveManaHitShieldBoon.name: Snow Queen
ReserveManaHitShieldBoon.description: Gain a barrier that stops {#BoldFormatGraft}1 {#Prev}instance of damage in each {$Keywords.RoomAlt}, but you {$Keywords.ReserveMana} {!Icons.Mana}.

ElementalDamageCapBoon.name: Frosty Veneer
ElementalDamageCapBoon.description: While you have at least {$TraitData.ElementalDamageCapBoon.ActivationRequirements.1.Value}{!Icons.CurseWater}, whenever you would take at least {$TraitData.ElementalDamageCapBoon.ActivatedDamageReductionThreshold} damage, take less.

InstantRootKill.name: Winter Harvest
InstantRootKill.description: {$Keywords.Root}-afflicted foes shatter at {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.TooltipDeathThreshold}%{#Prev}{!Icons.EnemyHealth}, dealing damage in the area.

InstantRootKill_FlavorText.name: Life is resilient, and can take root even in cold, harsh environments... but only to a point.

HestiaSprintBoon.name: Heat Rush
HestiaSprintBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.Sprint} leaves a cinder trail, and any damage you take from burning is reduced to {$TraitData.HestiaSprintBoon.DamageClamps.Value}.

HestiaCastBoon.name: Smolder Ring
HestiaCastBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.CastSet} repeatedly inflict {$Keywords.Burn} on foes in the binding circle.

AloneDamageBoon.name: Snuffed Candle

BurnArmorBoon.name: Hot Pot
BurnArmorBoon.description: Gain a chance to {$Keywords.Dodge}, which is doubled against {$Keywords.Burn}-afflicted foes.

BurnExplodeBoon.name: Flash Fry

CastProjectileBoon.name: Glowing Coal
CastProjectileBoon.description: Hold {$Keywords.Cast} to aim a fireball that explodes on impact. The binding circle forms there.

FireballManaSpecialBoon.name: Controlled Burn

OmegaZeroBurnBoon.name: Highly Flammable

ElementalBaseDamageBoon.name: Slow Cooker
ElementalBaseDamageBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.AttackSet} and {$Keywords.SpecialSet} gain {$Keywords.BaseDamage} the more {!Icons.CurseFire} you have.

BurnSprintBoon.name: Fire Away
BurnSprintBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.CastSet} destroy many foes' ranged shots, and inflict {$Keywords.Burn} on the attacking foes.

BurnSprintBoon_FlavorText.name: Flames can be a source of warmth and comfort, provided one is careful not to draw too close.

HephaestusWeaponBoon.name: Volcanic Strike

EncounterStartDefenseBuffBoon.name: Security System
EncounterStartDefenseBuffBoon.description: At the start of each {$Keywords.EncounterAlt}, gain {!Icons.ArmorTotal} that lasts for {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.TooltipDuration} Sec.

AntiArmorBoon.name: Molten Touch

HeavyArmorBoon.name: Heavy Metal

ManaToHealthBoon.name: Uncanny Fortitude

MassiveKnockupBoon.name: Furnace Blast

ElementalDamageBoon.name: Martial Art

AresSprintBoon.name: Stabbing Rush

OmegaDelayedDamageBoon.name: Cut Above
OmegaDelayedDamageBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.Omega} also cause a falling blade to appear over each foe struck, but use {#ManaFormat}+{$TooltipData.ExtractData.ManaCostAddition}{!Icons.Mana}{#Prev}.

AresManaBoon.name: Grisly Gain
AresManaBoon.description: Striking foes with your {$Keywords.WeaponSet} has {$TooltipData.ExtractData.TooltipDropChance:F} chance to spill {!Icons.BloodDropIcon}, which can restore {!Icons.Mana}.

AresManaBoon_Tray.description: Striking foes with your {$Keywords.WeaponSet} has {$TooltipData.ExtractData.TooltipDropChance:F} chance to spill {!Icons.BloodDropWithCountIcon}, which can restore {!Icons.Mana}.

RendBloodDropBoon.name: Profuse Bleeding
RendBloodDropBoon.description: Whenever you inflict {$Keywords.Rend} or collect {!Icons.BloodDropIcon}, create a falling blade over a surrounding foe.

RendBloodDropBoon_Tray.description: Whenever you inflict {$Keywords.Rend} or collect {!Icons.BloodDropWithCountIcon}, create a falling blade over a nearby foe.

AresStatusDoubleDamageBoon.name: Grievous Blow
AresStatusDoubleDamageBoon.description: Foes with {$Keywords.Rend} may suffer {$TraitData.AresStatusDoubleDamageBoon.DamagePercent:F} damage when struck.

BloodDropRevengeBoon.name: Visceral Impact
BloodDropRevengeBoon.description: After you take damage or a foe is slain, spill {!Icons.BloodDropIcon}, sometimes twice.

BloodDropRevengeBoon_Tray.description: After you take damage or a foe is slain, spill {!Icons.BloodDropWithCountIcon}, sometimes twice.

MissingHealthCritBoon.name: Mutual Destruction
MissingHealthCritBoon.description: Gain a chance to deal {$TraitData.AresStatusDoubleDamageBoon.DamagePercent:F} damage that increases the less {!Icons.Health} you have remaining.

AresExCastBoon.name: Meat Grinder
AresExCastBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.CastEX} also creates a {$Keywords.BladeRift} in the binding circle.

LowHealthLifestealBoon.name: Blood Spree
LowHealthLifestealBoon.description: While you have less than {$TooltipData.ExtractData.ReportedRequirement}{!Icons.Health}, your {$Keywords.AttackSet} and {$Keywords.SpecialSet} restore {!Icons.Health}.

DoubleBloodDropBoon.name: Sanguinary Savor
DoubleBloodDropBoon.description: You inflict {$Keywords.Rend} with greater {$Keywords.BaseDamage}, and spilled {!Icons.BloodDropIcon} is drawn to you automatically.

DoubleBloodDropBoon_FlavorText.name: If the sight of blood was truly so revolting, why then should it have such a striking hue?

ElementalOlympianDamageBoon.name: Rallying Cry
ElementalOlympianDamageBoon.description: While you have at least {$TraitData.ElementalOlympianDamageBoon.ActivationRequirements.1.Value}{!Icons.CurseEarth}, any of your damaging effects from Olympians are stronger.

HermesCastDiscountBoon.name: Winner's Circle
HermesCastDiscountBoon.description: You {$Keywords.Hold} your {$Keywords.CastEXNoTooltip} faster, and your {$Keywords.CastSet} deal damage and expire faster.

DodgeChanceBoon.name: Hasty Retreat
DodgeChanceBoon.description: Gain {$Keywords.Dodge} chance and move speed that increase the more {$Keywords.GodBoonPlural} you have.

SlowProjectileBoon.name: Hard Target
SlowProjectileBoon.description: Most foes' ranged shots are slower.

MoneyMultiplierBoon.name: Quick Buck
MoneyMultiplierBoon.description: Any {!Icons.Currency} you gain is worth more. Receive {#MoneyFormatBold}+{$ConsumableData.RoomMoneyDrop.ResourceCosts.Money}{#Prev}{!Icons.Currency} now, plus the bonus!

MoneyMultiplierBoon_Tray.description: Any {!Icons.Currency} you gain is worth more.

SprintShieldBoon.name: Nitro Boost
SprintShieldBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.Sprint} is {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.TooltipSpeed}% {#Prev}faster and gives you a barrier that ignores instances of damage.

TimedKillBuffBoon.name: Mean Streak
TimedKillBuffBoon.description: Whenever you slay a foe, deal more damage with your {$Keywords.WeaponSet} for the next {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Duration} Sec.

LuckyBoon.name: Success Rate
LuckyBoon.description: Your chance-based effects are more likely to occur, except for {$Keywords.Dodge} or {$Keywords.Blind}.

RestockBoon.name: Travel Deal
RestockBoon.description: Your first purchase in each {$Keywords.RoomAlt} costs less {!Icons.Currency}, and another item appears afterward.

ElementalUnifiedBoon.name: Tall Order
ElementalUnifiedBoon.description: While you have at least {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TraitData.ElementalUnifiedBoon.ActivationRequirements.[1].Value}{#Prev}{!Icons.EarthNoTooltip}, {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TraitData.ElementalUnifiedBoon.ActivationRequirements.[1].Value}{#Prev}{!Icons.WaterNoTooltip}, {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TraitData.ElementalUnifiedBoon.ActivationRequirements.[1].Value}{#Prev}{!Icons.AirNoTooltip}, {#ItalicFormat}or {#Prev}{#BoldFormatGraft}{$TraitData.ElementalUnifiedBoon.ActivationRequirements.[1].Value}{#Prev}{!Icons.AllElementsBoonHack}, you deal more damage.

TimeStopLastStandBoon.name: Paid Dues
TimeStopLastStandBoon.description: Whenever you take damage, you lose {!Icons.Currency} before you lose {!Icons.Health}.

TimeStopLastStandBoon_FlavorText.name: Wealth may not be a panacea, but it is at least a salve for many different kinds of pains.

InvulnerabilityDashBoon.name: Divine Dash
InvulnerabilityDashBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.Dash} deals damage to foes in your path and can momentarily {$Keywords.Deflect}.

RetaliateInvulnerabilityBoon.name: Defensive Posture
RetaliateInvulnerabilityBoon.description: After you take damage, become {$Keywords.Invulnerable} for {#BoldFormat}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Duration} Sec.

AthenaProjectileBoon.name: Phalanx Shot
AthenaProjectileBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.SpecialSet} also launch a projectile ahead that can {$Keywords.Deflect}, rearming after {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Cooldown} Sec.

InvulnerabilityCastBoon.name: Mental Block
InvulnerabilityCastBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.CastSet} also deal a burst of damage in the area and momentarily make you {$Keywords.Deflect}.

ManaSpearBoon.name: Righteous Pike
ManaSpearBoon.description: Whenever you use {#ManaFormat}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Mana}{#Prev}{!Icons.Mana}, up to {$TooltipData.ExtractData.Count} foes are struck by spears from the heavens.

FocusLastStandBoon.name: Stalwart Stand
FocusLastStandBoon.description: Gain {#BoldFormatGraft}+1 {#Prev}{$Keywords.ExtraChanceAthena} that replenishes in each {$Keywords.RoomAlt}, but you {$Keywords.ReserveMana} {!Icons.Mana}.

DeathDefianceRefillBoon.name: Renewed Faith
DeathDefianceRefillBoon.description: Replenish all spent uses of {$Keywords.ExtraChance} now, and improve their potency.

OlympianSpellCountBoon.name: Task Force
OlympianSpellCountBoon.description: If your {$Keywords.Spell} is {$Keywords.FirstTimeSpell}, that effect may activate multiple times in each {$Keywords.RoomAlt}.

OlympianSpellCountBoon_FlavorText.name: There are great warriors, and there are great leaders; some can even be both, but not at once.

CastLobBoon.name: Tipsy Shot
CastLobBoon.description: Hold {$Keywords.Cast} to lob a large explosive. The binding circle forms there.

HiddenMaxHealthBoon.name: Worry Free
HiddenMaxHealthBoon.description: Gain a random amount of {!Icons.HealthUp}, but how much you have becomes a mystery.

FirstHangoverBoon.name: Drunken Stupor
FirstHangoverBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.Omega} inflict {$Keywords.DamageOverTime} the first time they strike foes.

CombatEncounterHealBoon.name: Bounce Back
CombatEncounterHealBoon.description: After each {$Keywords.EncounterAlt}, restore some {!Icons.Health} if you took any damage in that {$Keywords.EncounterAlt}.

PowerDrinkBoon.name: Bottomless Drink
PowerDrinkBoon.description: In each {$Keywords.EncounterAlt}, {$Keywords.DrinkDrop} appears in the area and grants {$Keywords.BaseDamage} when collected.

FogDamageBonusBoon.name: Happy Haze
FogDamageBonusBoon.description: Every {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Interval} Sec. {#Prev}in each {$Keywords.EncounterAlt}, {$Keywords.Cloud} appears, making you stronger while in it.

BankBoon.name: Personal Loan
BankBoon.description: Give up {#ItalicFormat}all {#Prev}your {!Icons.Currency} now. After vanquishing the next {$Keywords.Boss}, gain that much and more.

BankBoon_Expired.description: Your loan has been repaid with {#MoneyFormatBold}+{$TooltipData.ExtractData.AmountGained}{!Icons.Currency} {#Prev}in interest.

BankBoon_Tray.description: After vanquishing the {$Keywords.Boss} of Olympus, gain previously-loaned {!Icons.Currency}, with interest.

RandomBaseDamageBoon.name: Reckless Abandon
RandomBaseDamageBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.AttackSet} randomly deal {#ItalicFormat}exactly {#Prev}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.MinDamage}, {$TraitData.RandomBaseDamageBoon.AddOutgoingDamageModifiers.RandomizedBaseDamage.[2].Value}, {#ItalicFormat}or {#Prev}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.MaxDamage} damage whenever they hit.

RandomBaseDamageBoon_FlavorText.name: Why struggle to always be in control, when instinct is always prepared to take the reins?

CritBonusBoon.name: Pressure Points
CritBonusBoon.description: Any damage you deal may be {$Keywords.Crit}.

TimedCritVulnerabilityBoon.name: Death Warrant
TimedCritVulnerabilityBoon.description: A random foe occasionally becomes {$Keywords.Mark}. If it takes {$Keywords.Crit} damage, this repeats.

DashOmegaBuffBoon.name: Shadow Pounce
DashOmegaBuffBoon.description: After you {$Keywords.Dash}, your {$Keywords.Omega} may deal {$Keywords.Crit} damage for {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Duration} Sec.

SupportingFireBoon.name: Support Fire
SupportingFireBoon.description: After you hit with your {$Keywords.AttackSet} or {$Keywords.SpecialSet}, fire a seeking arrow.

OmegaCastVolleyBoon.name: Easy Shot
OmegaCastVolleyBoon.description: A piercing arrow fires toward any foe damaged by your {$Keywords.CastEX}.

InsideCastCritBoon.name: Lethal Snare
InsideCastCritBoon.description: Foes in your {$Keywords.CastSet} may take {$Keywords.Crit} damage from your {$Keywords.AttackSet}.

HighHealthCritBoon.name: Vital Signs
HighHealthCritBoon.description: Foes with at least {#BoldFormat}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.HealthThreshold}%{#Prev}{!Icons.EnemyHealth} or {#BoldFormat}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.HealthThreshold}% {#Prev}{$Keywords.Armor} may take {$Keywords.Crit} damage.

FocusCritBoon.name: Killing Stroke
FocusCritBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.SpecialSet} may deal {$Keywords.Crit} damage, but you {$Keywords.ReserveMana} {#ManaFormat}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.TooltipCost}{#Prev}{!Icons.Mana}.

SorceryCritBoon_FlavorText.name: The Moon tends to provide just the amount of light that the huntress requires.

HadesLifestealBoon.name: Life Tax
HadesLifestealBoon.description: Restore {!Icons.Health} for {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Lifesteal}% {#Prev}of damage you deal, until you reach the limit.

HadesDeathDefianceDamageBoon.name: Last Gasp
HadesDeathDefianceDamageBoon.description: Deal more damage based on how many times you used {!Icons.ExtraChance} this night.

HadesCastProjectileBoon.name: Howling Soul
HadesCastProjectileBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.CastSet} launch a projectile that seeks foes. The binding circle forms where it hits.

HadesPreDamageBoon.name: Old Grudge
HadesPreDamageBoon.description: In your confrontation, {$TooltipData.ExtractData.FinalBoss} takes a burst of damage after the first {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TraitData.HadesPreDamageBoon.EncounterPreDamage.Delay} Sec.

HadesPreDamageBoon_DreamRun.name: Old Grudge
HadesPreDamageBoon_DreamRun.description: If you confront {$Keywords.CharChronos} or {$Keywords.CharTyphon}, they take a burst of damage after the first {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TraitData.HadesPreDamageBoon.EncounterPreDamage.Delay} Sec.

HadesChronosDebuffBoon.name: Deep Dissent
HadesChronosDebuffBoon.description: In your confrontation, {$TooltipData.ExtractData.FinalBoss} summons fewer reinforcements.

HadesChronosDebuffBoon_DreamRun.name: Deep Dissent
HadesChronosDebuffBoon_DreamRun.description: If you confront {$Keywords.CharChronos} or {$Keywords.CharTyphon}, they have fewer reinforcements to fight for them.

HadesDashSweepBoon.name: Gigaros Dash
HadesDashSweepBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.Dash} strikes surrounding foes with a punishing sweep that inflicts {$Keywords.HadesSweep}.

HadesManaUrnBoon.name: Cinerary Circle
HadesManaUrnBoon.description: Whenever you use {#ManaFormat}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Mana}{#Prev}{!Icons.Mana}, summon {$TraitData.HadesManaUrnBoon.OnManaSpendAction.FunctionArgs.Count} {$Keywords.HadesUrn} around you.

HadesInvisibilityRetaliateBoon.name: Unseen Ire
HadesInvisibilityRetaliateBoon.description: After you take damage, go {$Keywords.Invisible} and deal more damage for the duration.

HadesInvisibilityRetaliateBoon_FlavorTex.name: Darkness is the natural state of things, and a source of fear; for the world is a terrifying place.

SuperSacrificeBoonZeus.name: King's Ransom
SuperSacrificeBoonZeus.description: Give up {#ItalicFormat}all {#Prev}your {$Keywords.GodBoonPlural} of {#BoldFormatGraft}Hera{#Prev}. For each, raise {$Keywords.PomLevel} for {#ItalicFormat}all {#Prev}your {$Keywords.GodBoonPlural} of {#BoldFormatGraft}Zeus{#Prev}.

SuperSacrificeBoonHera.name: Queen's Ransom
SuperSacrificeBoonHera.description: Give up {#ItalicFormat}all {#Prev}your {$Keywords.GodBoonPlural} of {#BoldFormatGraft}Zeus{#Prev}. For each, raise {$Keywords.PomLevel} for {#ItalicFormat}all {#Prev}your {$Keywords.GodBoonPlural} of {#BoldFormatGraft}Hera{#Prev}.

LightningVulnerabilityBoon.name: Killer Current
LightningVulnerabilityBoon.description: Your lightning deals more damage to {$Keywords.KnockbackAmplify}-afflicted foes.

ApolloSecondStageCastBoon.name: Glorious Disaster
ApolloSecondStageCastBoon.description: You can {$Keywords.Hold} {#ManaFormat}+{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Cost}{#Prev}{!Icons.Mana} into your {$Keywords.CastEX} to repeatedly strike foes with lightning bolts.

RootStrikeBoon.name: Hail Storm
RootStrikeBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.Root} effects also cause lightning bolts to repeatedly strike afflicted foes.

SprintEchoBoon.name: Romantic Spark
SprintEchoBoon.description: {$Keywords.DashSet} into foes with {$Keywords.Echo} immediately activates the effect and makes it stronger.

ReboundingSparkBoon.name: Master Conductor
ReboundingSparkBoon.description: Your chain-lightning can bounce off of you and deals increasing damage to foes.

EchoBurnBoon.name: Thermal Dynamics
EchoBurnBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.Echo} effects also inflict {$Keywords.Burn} whenever they deal damage.

AutoRevengeBoon.name: Heinous Affront
AutoRevengeBoon.description: Inflicting {$Keywords.Rend} also can inflict all your {#ItalicLightFormat}'after you take damage' {#Prev}effects.

MoneyDamageBoon.name: Ripple Effect
MoneyDamageBoon.description: Your effects from {$TraitData.OmegaHeraProjectileBoon.Name} and {$TraitData.OmegaPoseidonProjectileBoon.Name} have a chance to fire {$ConstantsData.Two} times.

RaiseDeadBoon.name: Sun Worshiper
RaiseDeadBoon.description: In each {$Keywords.EncounterAlt}, the first foe you slay returns to fight for you.

KeepsakeLevelBoon.name: Cherished Heirloom
KeepsakeLevelBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.Keepsakes} are stronger this night {#ItalicFormat}(if possible){#Prev}.

CharmCrowdBoon.name: Ecstatic Obsession
CharmCrowdBoon.description: As long as multiple foes are in an {$Keywords.EncounterAlt}, automatically inflict {$Keywords.Charm} on {#BoldFormatGraft}1 {#Prev}of them.

ManaShieldBoon.name: Brave Face
ManaShieldBoon.description: Automatically use {!Icons.Mana} to resist up to {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.TooltipDamageBlocked}% {#Prev}of any damage.

ManaRestoreDamageBoon.name: Incandescent Aura
ManaRestoreDamageBoon.description: Whenever you restore {!Icons.Mana} during {$Keywords.EncounterPlural}, damage {#ItalicFormat}all {#Prev}{$Keywords.Link}-afflicted foes.

BloodRetentionBoon.name: Universal Donor
BloodRetentionBoon.description: Whenever you exit a {$Keywords.RoomAlt}, keep some of your {!Icons.BloodDropIcon} bonuses.

BloodRetentionBoon_Tray.description: Whenever you exit a {$Keywords.RoomAlt}, keep some of your {!Icons.BloodDropWithCountIcon} bonuses.

PoseidonSplashSprintBoon.name: Beach Ball
PoseidonSplashSprintBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.Sprint} creates a watery globe behind you, which surges ahead once you stop.

GoodStuffBoon.name: Natural Selection
GoodStuffBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.GodBoonPluralAlt} in the leftmost column gain {$Keywords.PomLevel} spread across however many you have.

AllCloseBoon.name: Island Getaway
AllCloseBoon.description: You take less damage from nearby foes. {$Keywords.GodBoonPlural} of {#BoldFormatGraft}Aphrodite {#Prev}treat all foes as nearby.

BoostedRecharge.name: Quickened!
BoostedRecharge.description: This effect recharges {$SessionMapState.DisplayedRechargeMultiplier:F} faster than usual due to {$TraitData.MassiveCastBoon.Name}.

MassiveCastBoon.name: Seismic Servo
MassiveCastBoon.description: Any {$Keywords.GodBoon} effects that recharge over time recharge faster.

SteamBoon.name: Scalding Vapor
SteamBoon.description: If foes with {$Keywords.KnockbackAmplify} are struck by your fire effects from {#BoldFormatGraft}Hestia{#Prev}, they are engulfed in {$Keywords.Steam}.

DoubleSplashBoon.name: Arterial Spray
DoubleSplashBoon.description: Your splash effects from {#BoldFormatGraft}Poseidon {#Prev}may hit {$TraitData.DoubleSplashBoon.NumHits} times {#ItalicLightFormat}(and take the color of the River Styx).

StormSpawnBoon.name: Tropical Cyclone
StormSpawnBoon.description: While standing in a {$Keywords.SlowField}, you randomly fire gales every {#BoldFormat}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Interval} Sec.

BlindClearBoon.name: Rude Awakening
BlindClearBoon.description: Your blast effects from {#BoldFormatGraft}Hephaestus {#Prev}clear {$Keywords.Blind} and deal more damage if they do.

CoverRegenerationBoon.name: Warm Breeze
CoverRegenerationBoon.description: Whenever you {$Keywords.Dodge} or {$Keywords.Blind} causes a foe to miss, restore some {!Icons.Health}.

DoubleSwordBoon.name: Cutting Edge
DoubleSwordBoon.description: Your falling blades from {#BoldFormat}Ares {#Prev}drop {#BoldFormatGraft}+1 {#Prev}time in succession and deal damage in a larger area.

MaxHealthDamageBoon.name: Hearty Appetite
MaxHealthDamageBoon.description: You deal more damage with your {$Keywords.WeaponSet} the more {!Icons.HealthUpTotal} you have.

ClearRootBoon.name: Cryo Pounder
ClearRootBoon.description: Your blast effects from {#BoldFormatGraft}Hephaestus {#Prev}deal more damage to {$Keywords.Root}-afflicted foes.

BurnConsumeBoon.name: Freezer Burn
BurnConsumeBoon.description: Whenever you inflict {$Keywords.Root} on a foe with {$Keywords.Burn}, deal damage and remove {$Keywords.Burn}.

SelfCastBoon.name: Hostile Environment
SelfCastBoon.description: Your {$Keywords.CastEX} is stronger and follows you, even as you start to {$Keywords.Hold} it.

SlamManaBurstBoon.name: Love Handles
SlamManaBurstBoon.description: Your blast effects from {#BoldFormatGraft}Hephaestus {#Prev} also create a {$Keywords.HeartBurst}.

BurnRefreshBoon.name: Burning Desire
BurnRefreshBoon.description: While foes are {$Keywords.Weak}, any {$Keywords.Burn} they have does not diminish as it deals damage.

BloodManaBurstBoon.name: Carnal Pleasure
BloodManaBurstBoon.description: Whenever you collect {!Icons.BloodDropIcon}, you may create a {$Keywords.HeartBurst}.

DoubleMassiveAttackBoon.name: Chain Reaction
DoubleMassiveAttackBoon.description: If you use your blast effects from {#BoldFormatGraft}Hephaestus {#Prev}just after they recharge, they fire {$TraitData.DoubleMassiveAttackBoon.NumAttacks} times.

RapidSwordBoon.name: Coffin Nail
RapidSwordBoon.description: Your falling blades from {#BoldFormatGraft}Ares {#Prev}fall immediately and deal more damage.

FireballRendBoon.name: Fourth Degree
FireballRendBoon.description: Your fireball effects from {#BoldFormatGraft}Hestia {#Prev}inflict {$Keywords.Rend} with even greater {$Keywords.BaseDamage}.

SpellLaserTrait.name: Lunar Ray
SpellLaserTrait.description: Your {$Keywords.Spell} fires a beam that deals up to {#UpgradeFormat}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Damage} {#Prev}damage over {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Duration} Sec.

SpellSummonTrait.name: Night Bloom
SpellSummonTrait.description: Your {$Keywords.Spell} raises the last susceptible foe slain this {$Keywords.EncounterAlt} to fight for you for {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Duration} Sec.

SpellTimeSlowTrait.name: Phase Shift
SpellTimeSlowTrait.description: Your {$Keywords.Spell} makes everything else move {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.SlowAmount}% {#Prev}slower for {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Duration} Sec.

SpellPotionTrait.name: Moon Water
SpellPotionTrait.description: Your {$Keywords.Spell} restores {#UpgradeFormat}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.HealingAmount}{!Icons.Health} {#Prev}up to {$TraitData.SpellPotionTrait.MaxUses} times, which replenish whenever you use {$Keywords.FountainPlural}.

SpellMeteorTrait.name: Total Eclipse
SpellMeteorTrait.description: Your {$Keywords.Spell} blasts a large target area for {#UpgradeFormat}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Damage} {#Prev}damage after {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Fuse} Sec.

SpellLeapTrait.name: Wolf Howl
SpellLeapTrait.description: Your {$Keywords.Spell} makes you rise up then crash down in the target area for {#UpgradeFormat}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Damage} {#Prev}damage.

SpellPolymorphTrait.name: Twilight Curse
SpellPolymorphTrait.description: Your {$Keywords.Spell} launches a seeking projectile that inflicts {$Keywords.Polymorph} on up to {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Bounces} {#Prev}susceptible foes.

SpellTransformTrait.name: Dark Side
SpellTransformTrait.description: Your {$Keywords.Spell} turns you into an {$Keywords.Invulnerable} living nightmare with her own abilities for {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Duration} Sec.

SpellMoonBeamTrait.name: Sky Fall
SpellMoonBeamTrait.description: Your {$Keywords.Spell} inflicts {$Keywords.MoonBeamVulnerability} and deals {$TooltipData.ExtractData.MoonBeamDamage} damage to a random surrounding foe, {$TooltipData.ExtractData.MoonBeamCount} times.

OlympianSpellCountTalent.name: Lineage
OlympianSpellCountTalent.description: Your {$Keywords.Spell} can be {$Keywords.FirstTimeSpell} {#UpgradeFormat}+{$TooltipData.StatDisplay1} {#Prev}time when used in {$Keywords.Boss} {$Keywords.EncounterPlural}.

ManaDiscountTalent.name: Readiness
ManaDiscountTalent.description: You use {$TooltipData.StatDisplay1}{!Icons.Mana} less than before to recharge your {$Keywords.Spell}.

MinorManaDiscountTalent.name: Alertness
MinorManaDiscountTalent.description: You use {$TooltipData.StatDisplay1}{!Icons.Mana} less than before to recharge your {$Keywords.Spell}.

PreChargeTalent.name: Preparation
PreChargeTalent.description: Whenever you enter a {$Keywords.RoomAlt}, your {$Keywords.Spell} starts {#UpgradeFormat}{$TooltipData.StatDisplay1} {#Prev}charged.

ChargeRegenTalent.name: Growth
ChargeRegenTalent.description: Your {$Keywords.Spell} also charges up automatically as though you used {$TooltipData.StatDisplay1}{!Icons.Mana} every {#BoldFormat}1 Sec.

CooldownDamageTalent.name: Purpose
CooldownDamageTalent.description: After using your {$Keywords.Spell}, you deal {$TooltipData.StatDisplay1} damage this {$Keywords.EncounterAlt}.

LaserDamageTalent.name: Intensity
LaserDamageTalent.description: Your {$Keywords.Spell} has {#UpgradeFormat}+{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Damage} {#Prev}{$Keywords.BaseDamage} over the course of every {#BoldFormatGraft}1 Sec.

LaserDefenseTalent.name: Bearing
LaserDefenseTalent.description: Whenever you use your {$Keywords.Spell}, gain {#UpgradeFormat}+{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Defense}{#Prev}{!Icons.ArmorTotal} that lasts for the duration of the effect.

LaserCrystalTalent.name: Prominence
LaserCrystalTalent.description: Your {$Keywords.Spell} continually aims and fires on its own from wherever you use it.

LaserStartAoETalent.name: Overflow
LaserStartAoETalent.description: Your {$Keywords.Spell} also deals {#UpgradeFormat}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Damage} {#Prev}damage every {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Fuse} Sec. {#Prev}in an area around you.

LaserAoETalent.name: Dispersion
LaserAoETalent.description: Your {$Keywords.Spell} deals damage in an area at the end point.

LaserFirstHitDamageTalent.name: Contact
LaserFirstHitDamageTalent.description: Whenever you use your {$Keywords.Spell}, it has {#UpgradeFormat}+{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Damage} {#Prev}{$Keywords.BaseDamage} the first time it deals damage.

LaserDurationTalent.name: Obstinance
LaserDurationTalent.description: Your {$Keywords.Spell} fires for up to {#UpgradeFormat}+{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Time} Sec.

LaserTripleTalent.name: Trinity
LaserTripleTalent.description: Your {$Keywords.Spell} fires {#UpgradeFormat}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Projectiles} {#Prev}beams in a fan pattern.

LaserPrimaryTalent.name: Disintegration
LaserPrimaryTalent.description: Your {$Keywords.Spell} gains the bonuses of your {$Keywords.AttackBoon}.

LaserApolloTalent.name: Shine of Apollo
LaserApolloTalent.description: Your {$Keywords.Spell} can be {$Keywords.FirstTimeSpell}: Fire a bigger solar-infused ray with {#UpgradeFormat}+{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Damage} {#Prev}{$Keywords.BaseDamage}.

SuitComboDoubleSpecialTrait.name: Awakened Rockets
SuitComboDoubleSpecialTrait.description: Absorbing {$Keywords.SpecialEX} blasts also creates blasts from your {$Keywords.Special}, but you lose {#ManaFormat}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Cost}{#Prev}{!Icons.Mana}.

SuitComboDashAttackTrait.name: Mooncrest Riser
SuitComboDashAttackTrait.description: Your {$Keywords.DashStrike} hits a larger area and deals {#UpgradeFormat}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.ReportedBonus:P} {#Prev}damage.

WeaponStaffSwing.name: Witch's Staff
WeaponStaffSwing.description: Strike with a quick close-range {$Keywords.Attack}, or long-range {$Keywords.SpecialSet} and {$Keywords.Omega}.

WeaponStaffSwing_FlavorText.name: Descura, also called the Staff of Dusk, grows stronger in obscurity.

WeaponDagger.name: Sister Blades
WeaponDagger.description: Slash with furious {$Keywords.AttackSet}, or strike from afar with a flurry of {$Keywords.SpecialSet}.

WeaponDagger_FlavorText.name: The Sister Blades Lim and Oros serve the Unseen, and are never separated.

WeaponAxe.name: Moonstone Axe
WeaponAxe.description: Sweep through foes with a slow but devastating variety of {$Keywords.AttackSet} and {$Keywords.SpecialSet}.

WeaponAxe_FlavorText.name: Zorephet was to be a labrys so broad as could conceal the Moon herself.

WeaponTorch.name: Umbral Flames
WeaponTorch.description: Launch damaging ranged {$Keywords.AttackSet} as you move, or {$Keywords.SpecialSet} that orbit around you.

WeaponTorch_FlavorText.name: The Flames of Ygnium burn with an extraordinary light that does not pierce the dark.

WeaponLob.name: Argent Skull
WeaponLob.description: Blast foes with explosive {$Keywords.AttackSet}, and retrieve the {$Keywords.Shells} with lunging {$Keywords.SpecialSet}.

WeaponLob_FlavorText.name: Revaal's final honor as Adjudicator was to become immortalized in adamant and death.

WeaponSuit.name: Black Coat
WeaponSuit.description: Guard and retaliate with mighty {$Keywords.AttackSet}, ensuring none escape with seeking {$Keywords.SpecialSet}.

WeaponSuit_FlavorText.name: Those wreathed in the darkness of Xinth are extensions of the Underworld's force of will.

ToolPickaxe.name: Crescent Pick
ToolPickaxe.description: Used for gathering valuable {!Icons.OreFSilverIcon} and other minerals.

ToolPickaxe_FlavorText.name: Its engravings suggest the humility and restraint expected of its bearer.

ToolPickaxe2.name: Crescent Pick
ToolPickaxe2.description: {$Keywords.PickaxePointPlural} have {#UpgradeFormat}{$WeaponShopItemData.ToolPickaxe2.ElementChancePercent:F} {#Prev}chance to yield {#UpgradeFormat}+1{#Prev}{!Icons.FireBoonAlt}, once this night.

ToolExorcismBook.name: Tablet of Peace
ToolExorcismBook.description: Used for placating {$Keywords.ExorcismPointPlural}, which yields {!Icons.MemPointsCommonIcon} for the {$Keywords.CardTable}.

ToolExorcismBook_FlavorText.name: Some Shades are incapable of deceit; fewer still are fit to join the cause.

ToolExorcismBook2.name: Tablet of Peace
ToolExorcismBook2.description: {$Keywords.ExorcismPointPlural} have {#UpgradeFormat}{$WeaponShopItemData.ToolExorcismBook2.ElementChancePercent:F} {#Prev}chance to yield {#UpgradeFormat}+1{#Prev}{!Icons.AirBoonAlt}, once this night.

ToolShovel.name: Silver Spade
ToolShovel.description: Used for digging up {!Icons.SeedMysteryIcon} and other valuables beneath the Earth.

ToolShovel_FlavorText.name: It is said to uncover only that which Gaia willingly bestows.

ToolShovel2.name: Silver Spade
ToolShovel2.description: {$Keywords.DiggingPointPlural} have {#UpgradeFormat}{$WeaponShopItemData.ToolShovel2.ElementChancePercent:F} {#Prev}chance to yield {#UpgradeFormat}+1{#Prev}{!Icons.EarthBoonAlt}, once this night.

ToolFishingRod.name: Rod of Fishing
ToolFishingRod.description: Used for capturing river denizens to trade for {!Icons.MetaCurrencyIcon}.

ToolFishingRod_FlavorText.name: Poseidon himself anointed this device, and authorized its use.

ToolFishingRod2.name: Rod of Fishing
ToolFishingRod2.description: {$Keywords.FishingPointPlural} have {#UpgradeFormat}{$WeaponShopItemData.ToolFishingRod2.ElementChancePercent:F} {#Prev}chance to yield {#UpgradeFormat}+1{#Prev}{!Icons.WaterBoonAlt}, once this night.

BaseStaffAspect_FlavorText.name: A waxing crescent moon; the promise of power, the responsibility to ready oneself.

StaffClearCastAspect.name: Aspect of Circe
StaffClearCastAspect.description: Whenever you use {$Keywords.CastSet}, so does your {$Keywords.Familiar}, forming a {$Keywords.FamiliarBuff}.

StaffClearCastAspect_FlavorText.name: A high priestess of the Unseen once used the staff to bring about necessary change.

StaffSelfHitAspect.name: Aspect of Momus
StaffSelfHitAspect.description: Whenever you use {$Keywords.Omega}, each fires in place up to {$TooltipData.ExtractData.StrikeCount} times until you use it again.

StaffSelfHitAspect_FlavorText.name: Not even ever-patient Night herself spared much time for his insolence.

StaffRaiseDeadAspect.name: Aspect of Anubis
StaffRaiseDeadAspect.description: You have the {$Keywords.RaiseDeadAspect}, which raises {$Keywords.ShadeMerc} wherever you slay foes.

StaffRaiseDeadAspect_FlavorText.name: Behind the leering maw of a black jackal, a staunch protector of the dead.

DaggerBackstabAspect.name: Aspect of Melinoë
DaggerBackstabAspect.description: Your {$Keywords.AttackSet} and {$Keywords.SpecialSet} deal more damage by striking foes from behind.

DaggerBackstabAspect_FlavorText.name: As there are many gardens to be cultivated, such a task requires precision instruments.

DaggerBlockAspect.name: Aspect of Artemis
DaggerBlockAspect.description: While you {$Keywords.Hold} your {$Keywords.AttackEX}, you occasionally {$Keywords.Block}, then {$Keywords.DaggerBlockBuff} right after.

DaggerBlockAspect_FlavorText.name: A flash of silver; whether the Huntress or the Moon, none can attest.

DaggerHomingThrowAspect.name: Aspect of Pan
DaggerHomingThrowAspect.description: Your {$Keywords.SpecialSet} seek foes in your {$Keywords.CastSet}, and fire more shots if you {$Keywords.Hold} longer.

DaggerHomingThrowAspect_FlavorText.name: The natural-grown horn can pierce as readily as a well-crafted blade.

DaggerTripleAspect.name: Aspect of the Morrigan
DaggerTripleAspect.description: You have the {$Keywords.TripleAspect}, which can perform the ritual of the {$Keywords.TripleAspectStrike}.

DaggerTripleAspect_Shop.name: Sister Blades, Aspect of the Morrigan

DaggerTripleAspect_FlavorText.name: They are three or she is one, this distant phantom queen foretold by the call of the crow.

TorchSpecialDurationAspect_FlavorText.name: No single light can illuminate the many crossroads ahead; thus there are two.

TorchDetonateAspect.name: Aspect of Moros
TorchDetonateAspect.description: Your {$Keywords.AttackSet} linger for {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.TotalDuration} Sec.{#Prev}, and explode in a blast if struck by your {$Keywords.SpecialSet}.

TorchDetonateAspect_FlavorText.name: Feared and hated Doom lingers like a sword about to fall; even his time shall come.

TorchSprintRecallAspect.name: Aspect of Eos
TorchSprintRecallAspect.description: Your {$Keywords.AttackEX} fires a {$Keywords.EosAspectShot} that deals damage in an area around it every {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Fuse} Sec.

TorchSprintRecallAspect_FlavorText.name: Rosy-fingered Dawn is mistress of a certain light more captivating than any other.

TorchAutofireAspect.name: Aspect of Supay
TorchAutofireAspect.description: You have the {$Keywords.AutofireAspect}, which also enhance your {$Keywords.SprintBoonAlt}.

TorchAutofireAspect_FlavorText.name: Plunge deep enough into the Earth and the daemons therein only grow stronger.

AxeRecoveryAspect_FlavorText.name: Its twin blade can split even the light of the Moon, yet itself can never be separated.

AxeArmCastAspect.name: Aspect of Charon
AxeArmCastAspect.description: Your {$Keywords.Cast} erupts like a stronger {$Keywords.CastEX} if struck by your {$Keywords.SpecialEX}.

AxeArmCastAspect_FlavorText.name: To navigate the rivers of the Underworld is to possess extraordinary poise and strength.

AxePerfectCriticalAspect.name: Aspect of Thanatos
AxePerfectCriticalAspect.description: Your {$Keywords.Attack} is faster, and each strike grants {$Keywords.ThanatosAspectBuff} until you take damage.

AxePerfectCriticalAspect_FlavorText.name: Death comes peacefully for many mortals; yet for foes of the realm, exceptions must be made.

AxeRallyAspect.name: Aspect of Nergal
AxeRallyAspect.description: You have the {$Keywords.RallyAspect}, and become {$Keywords.FrenzyBuff} after you strike enough foes.

AxeRallyAspect_FlavorText.name: Most mortal lives are naturally short; he seeks to cut them shorter still in a variety of ways.

LobAmmoBoostAspect.name: Aspect of Melinoë
LobAmmoBoostAspect.description: Your {$Keywords.AttackSet} have more {$Keywords.BaseDamage} for each {$Keywords.Shell} fired and not yet retrieved.

LobAmmoBoostAspect_FlavorText.name: The will of Night is never to be chronicled, but witnessed by the dead and the shadow.

LobCloseAttackAspect.name: Aspect of Medea
LobCloseAttackAspect.description: Your {$Keywords.Attack} stays within reach, and explodes after landing your {$Keywords.SpecialSet} or {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Duration} Sec.

LobCloseAttackAspect_FlavorText.name: She shall find comfort in the skulls of her foes remaining ever close at hand; one especially.

LobImpulseAspect.name: Aspect of Persephone
LobImpulseAspect.description: Your {$Keywords.SpecialEX} is {$Keywords.Fuel}, and lets you change direction; {$Keywords.GodBoonPlural} start with {$Keywords.PomLevel}

LobImpulseAspect_FlavorText.name: Life and death, forever embodied in a Queen both splendorous and dark at once.

LobGunAspect.name: Aspect of Hel
LobGunAspect.description: You have {$Keywords.GunAspect}, which grants the way of the {$Keywords.Overheat} after your {$Keywords.SpecialEX}.

LobGunAspect_FlavorText.name: There, in her realm, the dead are entombed in the frost beneath the world's roots.

BaseSuitAspect.name: Aspect of Melinoë
BaseSuitAspect.description: Your {$Keywords.AttackSet}, {$Keywords.Sprint}, and move speed are faster.

BaseSuitAspect_FlavorText.name: Darkness spreads, both of its own volition and by the impetus of those sufficiently devoted.

SuitHexAspect.name: Aspect of Selene
SuitHexAspect.description: You start with {$TraitData.SpellMoonBeamTrait.Name}, a hidden {$Keywords.Spell} that strikes multiple foes and applies {$Keywords.MoonBeamVulnerability}.

SuitHexAspect_FlavorText.name: Which other strengths and mysteries does she in her bright chariot withhold?

SuitComboAspect.name: Aspect of Shiva
SuitComboAspect.description: You have {$Keywords.ComboAspect}, which absorbs {$Keywords.SpecialEX} blasts to grow {$Keywords.ComboBuff}.

SuitComboAspect_FlavorText.name: The supreme destroyer requires but four capable hands, yet perhaps has a hundred.

SuitMarkCritAspect.name: Aspect of Nyx
SuitMarkCritAspect.description: You have {$Keywords.NyxSprint}, which lets you produce {$Keywords.NyxAspectBuff} after you activate it.

SuitMarkCritAspect_FlavorText.name: Night is the cold and steady state of the world; a source of calm as well as fright.

TemporaryBoonRarityTrait.name: Yarn of Ariadne
TemporaryBoonRarityTrait.description: Ensure the next {$Keywords.GodBoon} you find includes blessings with greater {$Keywords.Rarity}.

TemporaryEmptySlotDamageTrait.name: Danaid Dagger
TemporaryEmptySlotDamageTrait.description: Your {$Keywords.AttackSet} and {$Keywords.SpecialSet} deal {#UpgradeFormat}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.TooltipBonus:P} {#Prev}damage while not empowered by {$Keywords.GodBoonPlural}.

FirstHitHealTrait.name: Breath of Eros
FirstHitHealTrait.description: Whenever you would next take damage, receive {!Icons.HealthRestore} in that amount instead.

LimitedManaRegenDrop.name: Mist Veil
LimitedManaRegenDrop.description: After you use {!Icons.Mana}, restore it over {#BoldFormat}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.TooltipDuration} Sec.{#Prev}, up to a total of {#ManaFormat}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.TooltipManaRecovery}{!Icons.Mana}{#Prev}.

LimitedSwapTraitDrop.name: Sacrificial Hymn
LimitedSwapTraitDrop.description: {$Keywords.TraitExchangeAlt} will be offered as soon as possible, and your next gains {#AltUpgradeFormat}+{$TraitData.LimitedSwapBonusTrait.ExchangeLevelBonus}{#Prev} {$Keywords.PomLevel}

RandomStoreItem.name: Fateful Twist
RandomStoreItem.description: Gain a random item offered from the {$Keywords.WellShop} now.

TemporaryForcedSecretDoorTrait.name: Spark of Ixion
TemporaryForcedSecretDoorTrait.description: Ensure a {$Keywords.HealthGate} spawns ahead as soon as possible. It costs {#UpgradeFormat}0{#Prev}{!Icons.Health} to enter.

TemporaryDiscountTrait.name: Ferry Voucher
TemporaryDiscountTrait.description: Ensure any goods offered by {$Keywords.CharCharon} cost {#UpgradeFormat}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.TooltipDiscount}% {#Prev}less.

ExtendedShopTrait.name: Archaic Seal
ExtendedShopTrait.description: Your next {$Keywords.WellShop} item with a duration will instead expire after {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Boss} {#Prev}{$Keywords.BossPluralAlt}.

StackUpgrade.name: Pom of Power
StackUpgrade.description: Choose {#BoldFormat}1 {#Prev}out of {$ScreenData.UpgradeChoice.MaxChoices} random blessings you now have to give it {#UpgradeFormat}+1{#Prev}{$Keywords.PomLevel}

StackUpgradeBig.name: Mega Pom of Power
StackUpgradeBig.description: Choose {#BoldFormat}1 {#Prev}out of {$ScreenData.UpgradeChoice.MaxChoices} random blessings you now have to give it {#UpgradeFormat}+{$LootSetData.Loot.StackUpgradeBig.StackNum}{#Prev}{$Keywords.PomLevel}

StackUpgradeTriple.name: Giga Pom of Power
StackUpgradeTriple.description: Choose {#BoldFormat}1 {#Prev}out of {$ScreenData.UpgradeChoice.MaxChoices} random blessings you now have to give it {#UpgradeFormat}+{$LootSetData.Loot.StackUpgradeTriple.StackNum}{#Prev}{$Keywords.PomLevel}

TalentDrop.name: Path of Stars
TalentDrop.description: Receive your choice of at least {$ConsumableData.TalentDrop.AddTalentPoints} or more linked upgrades for your {$Keywords.Spell}.

MinorTalentDrop.name: Faint Path of Stars
MinorTalentDrop.description: Receive your choice of at least {$ConsumableData.MinorTalentDrop.AddTalentPoints} upgrade for your {$Keywords.Spell}.

TalentBigDrop.name: Gleaming Path of Stars
TalentBigDrop.description: Receive your choice of {$ConsumableData.TalentBigDrop.AddTalentPoints} or more linked upgrades for your {$Keywords.Spell}.

StorePendingDeliveryItem.name: Special Order
StorePendingDeliveryItem.description: Your {$TooltipData.ItemDisplayName} order from the {#BoldFormat}Shrine of Hermes {#Prev}is on its way.

BlindBoxLoot.name: Mystery Boon
BlindBoxLoot.description: Receive a {$Keywords.GodBoon} from one of the Olympians... {#ItalicFormat}but who?

WeaponUpgrade.name: Daedalus Hammer
WeaponUpgrade.description: Receive your choice of {#BoldFormat}1 {#Prev}out of {$ScreenData.UpgradeChoice.MaxChoices} random enchantments for your {$Keywords.Weapon}.

HermesUpgrade_Store.name: Boon of Hermes
HermesUpgrade_Store.description: Receive your choice of {#BoldFormat}1 {#Prev}out of {$ScreenData.UpgradeChoice.MaxChoices} {$Keywords.GodBoonPlural} from {#BoldFormat}Hermes{#Prev}.

SpellDrop_Store.name: Gift of the Moon
SpellDrop_Store.description: Receive your choice of {#BoldFormat}1 {#Prev}{$Keywords.Spell} out of {$ScreenData.UpgradeChoice.MaxChoices} random choices from {$Keywords.CharSelene}.
